description:
_project/scripts/green_unmerged_sweep.py main(): when nothing is stranded and no PR has hidden failures, the issue body is rewritten only if it lacks "No stranded PRs" or says "develop post-merge is RED". A body with a hidden-failure section also contains "No stranded PRs", so it is never refreshed; #1508 still lists merged #4154 as blocking.

Change: treat a body that contains the hidden-failure heading as stale too, so the one-time clear rewrite happens. Keep the sweep silent in steady state.

Scope: _project/scripts/green_unmerged_sweep.py, tests/unit/scripts/test_green_unmerged_sweep.py, _project/scripts/fixtures/green_unmerged_fixture.json if needed.
